topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These introductory remarks welcome the students and establish the lecture's learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how pre-malignant tissues acquire competitive growth advantages through progressive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of origin and the cancer stem cell model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tissue differentiation hierarchies and stemness properties influence tumor initiation and propagation in leukemia and intestinal cancers.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how extrinsic inflammation and supportive stromal interactions provide permissive conditions that promote and maintain tumor growth.

topics.label: Technologies for investigating tumor architecture and evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic discusses experimental, sequencing, and spatial profiling methods used to analyze tumor cell dynamics and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Integrative evolutionary model of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesises how genetic mutations, cellular origins, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental signals converge in the Darwinian evolution of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: This closing statement concludes the presentation and announces the topic of the upcoming lecture.
